verdict.rationale: A community report confirms the RCLI repo is MIT-licensed, and a public GitHub SDK repo exists, so some source is readable under an open license. The same report and another comment say the MetalRT inference engine is commercial and proprietary, so the openness is incomplete. Missing for 10: first-party license documentation for the SDK repo, open source for the core inference engine (MetalRT), and a clear statement of which components are open.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: this RCLI is only MIT license but their engine MetalRT is commercial
